companion.title: Link a phone
companion.subtitle: Scan the code with CADCAMFUN on your phone. The phone joins the account you are using on this computer, and projects stay in sync over the live connection.
companion.status.off: Off. Nothing is reachable from other devices.
companion.pair.expires: This code expires in {time} and works once.
companion.pair.expired: This code has expired. Show a new one.
companion.pair.name: Device name
companion.pair.hint: Open CADCAMFUN on your phone, choose Scan QR code and point the camera here, or paste the link below. Phone and Mac must share Wi-Fi, Personal Hotspot or Tailscale — cellular 5G cannot reach this computer. The code is single-use and expires in two minutes. The phone then uses this computer's signed-in account.
companion.error.load: Could not load the companion settings
